name: Gaius Marius
summary: A "new man" from outside Rome's old families who became its leading general. He recruited landless volunteers, whose loyalty went to their commander.
moments: Ends the war with Jugurtha in Africa, 105 BCE
Defeats the Cimbri and Teutones, 102–101 BCE
Driven out of Rome by Sulla, 88 BCE
fate: Died of illness in January 86 BCE, days into his seventh consulship.
